description: This file defines the createDuration function for constructing duration objects from various input formats, including ISO and ASP.NET date formats, and includes utility functions for date difference calculations within the Moment.js library.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: Class representing a duration of time, constructed within createDuration.

methods.name: createDuration
methods.description: Creates a Duration object from various input formats, including existing Duration, number, ISO string, or ASP.NET date string.

methods.name: parseIso
methods.description: Parses ISO duration components, applying sign and handling undefined input.

methods.name: positiveMomentsDifference
methods.description: Calculates the difference in milliseconds and months between two moments, assuming the first is before the second.

methods.name: momentsDifference
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two moments, considering their validity and offset.
